method: Extracted 4 original JPEGs from their exact canonical GitHub Actions acquisition artifacts; independently SHA256 checked against canonical registry and opened full composition and simulated 9:16 phone crops. This is exact-image visual evidence, not unverified web thumbnails or complete rights clearance.

images.title: Expectant Madonna with Saint Joseph
images.visualObservation: NGA 1952.5.32 exact tempera panel: Mary pregnant dominant full length, Saint Joseph in red robe behind at right; two angels flanking, embroidered gold background. Full image visually high clarity, vivid late-medieval colouring; nevertheless principally an Expectant Madonna and Saint Joseph is supporting actor, not solo portrait.
images.displayConstraint: No forced close crop: top heraldic canopy and bottom feet/context would be lost. Medieval style conditional for a devotional chapter, not Home hero.

images.title: Saint Benedict
images.visualObservation: Met 24.78c original contains Benedict with book in dark habit and two saints in upper register, plus original dark architectural wood frame/panel. Visually confirms correct Benedict, not the superficially similar Met Sylvester panel 24.78b. Sharp enough art-historic object but flat medieval gold, upper compartments and extant integral framing preclude premium portrait hero. Zurbarán preferred.
images.displayConstraint: Keep source panel intact as a historical altarpiece object; any crop to isolated Benedict requires explicit editorial consent and source-object accuracy.

images.title: The Good Samaritan
images.visualObservation: Met 30.31 workshop of Domenico Fetti: muted brownish-green landscape with small central injured man supported on donkey and Samaritan in travel scene. Correct original visibly very low contrast, small biblical figures, hazy surface; poor narrative readability even in full frame; cannot substitute Dresden or other autograph Fetti versions.
images.displayConstraint: Avoid Home/phone hero. If used anywhere, only full-image historical parable supporting illustration and caption WORKSHOP of Fetti.

images.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
images.visualObservation: Maestro Bartolomé K2017 original shows Christ entering Jerusalem seated on donkey, standing disciples at left, kneeling/welcoming figures on right, palm branches, and Gothic walls/towers. Clear exact Palm Sunday iconography and vivid Renaissance-Gothic colours. Visually quite narratively legible on full image, but flattened archaizing painterly style less aligned with preferred Baroque. This is the correct earlier chosen Kress original, not Pietro Lorenzetti.
images.displayConstraint: Retain previous human Palm Sunday placement; do not silently revoke, replace, elevate to current 101 approved, or use without Kress reproduction rights and final crop approval.
